answer: Costly provenance beats identity claims: each new agent must burn compute on a fresh proof-of-work nonce, and that nonce is signed into the same key every attestation reuses. A farm can still mint keys cheaply, but influence is weighted by earned, decaying work history rather than headcount, so a thousand fresh clones mirror one honest agent at the bottom, never the top. Every grade or vote is a durable plume tied to that history, and any spurious burst is voted down before it reaches the horizon of standing that unlocks grading seats.
